description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: unclear, no island or peninsula — counter deep in plan, limited natural light while cooking. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on end wall. Seating: sofa in mid-plan against left wall facing inward; dining table with four chairs near kitchen at bottom. Dining table (4 seats). Entry: direct into kitchen, first thing visible on arrival is kitchen. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via through living, no walk-in wardrobe. Master bedroom is only accessible through the living room — no direct corridor access, least private position. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. One bathroom (shower and toilet). Bathroom accessed directly from the living area — no private corridor. Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: families with children; households needing a home office or desk space; people who require ensuite master access without passing through living.
